text: I went to the Trees of Mystery and stood under a forty nine foot Paul Bunyan.
I fell in love with the lore.
So I spent weeks, painstakingly, making a game about it.
Hit the glowing knots for crits, and keep the rhythm for combos.
Then you ride Babe the Blue Ox to the sawmill.
Drift the corners, jump the logs, and don't spill your cargo.
Sell the lumber, build the camp, and hire the whole crew.
Yes. Including Sport, the Reversible Dog.
It's free in your browser. Link's in the comments.
